_version: Admin settings for CurWork Beta 0.017 - DRAFT - For Internal Use (FPT) - updated 2026-11-23 01:38 UTC - modified by: mbitar
_help: PROTECTED laptop settings. Put this file next to CurWork.exe (or CurWork.app) in a folder billers can read but not change. It only holds what CurWork needs to sign in. Everything else (the bucket, S3 folders, encryption key, work folder and file rules) is kept in AWS Parameter Store and changed with the CurWork admin settings app. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored.
_use_fips_endpoint_help: true makes every AWS call, including sign-in, use the government-grade (FIPS) encrypted endpoints.
_aws_cli_path_help: Optional full path to aws.exe. Empty = look in Program Files, then PATH (never the current folder).
_login_banner_help: Optional system-use notice (NIST 800-53 AC-8) shown before sign-in. Billers must click OK to continue.
_settings_parameter_help: Optional. The Parameter Store name that holds the rest of the settings. Leave it out to use /curwork/admin-settings.
_sso_help: Optional. If filled in, CurWork adds the AWS profile to the laptop the first time a biller clicks Sign in.
